overall_summary: Data clearly shows that relationship and marriage-focused content significantly outperforms general sad shayari or broader family topics. Specifically, 'Husband Wife' dynamics drive the highest views and engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1674 views) heavily outperform everything else.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more micro-narratives focused on married life struggles, emotional distance, and unspoken appreciation between partners.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 17 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or abstract heartbreak lines; ground the emotion in concrete, recognizable everyday interactions.

next_video.concept: A husband notices his wife has stopped sharing her daily trivial updates with him, realizing silence has quietly replaced arguments.

next_video.posting_window: 13:00 - 14:00 (Based on top performing high-view videos published around midday/early afternoon)
